A.name: The Slow Bleed
A.summary: Bessent caps the long end. Japan leaks capital home without a full crack. Auctions soften but never fail. Dollar drifts down 3–5%/year. Gold compounds 12–15%. BTC grinds, no explosion.
A.outcome: 65+ plan gets funded but not extravagantly.

B.name: The Japan Shock
B.summary: A Japanese institution reallocates out of USTs as 40Y JGB hits 5%+. Yen carry unwinds (USD/JPY 180 then 140). UST 30Y gaps to 6%+. Ugly 1.8x auction. Gold/BTC gap.
B.outcome: Base-case bull. 65+ plan overfunded. Optionality for Lisbon/Medellín while keeping the Katy house.

C.name: The Treasury Seizure
C.summary: An auction fails. 10Y spikes 150bps in a month. DXY through 90. EM dollar-debt cascade. Gold limit-up. BTC mania then 40% retrace as regulation slams down.
C.outcome: The 10x. Real gains, messy exit (tax, reporting, withdrawal limits).

D.name: The Muddle Through
D.summary: AI productivity, spending cuts, or a growth surprise let the US grow out of debt-to-GDP. Gold range-bound. BTC trades like a tech stock. Optionality thesis fails.
D.outcome: Not catastrophic. The hedge did not pay.
